_comment: EXAMPLE template. opp Id -> one or more Slack channels for the deal. An opp can have several relevant channels (dedicated deal channel, account channel, sibling/program channel). week-ahead appends resolved channels so future runs are instant. Key = 18-char Opportunity Id. Copy this to channel-map.json (gitignored) and let the skill populate it — never commit real channel IDs / account names to a public repo.
_schema: channels[oppId] = { oppName, account, channels: [ { channelId, channelName, role, verified, note? } ] }  — role ∈ dedicated | account | sibling | program | weak
